acceptance.criterion: Hosted ledger identity enters the canonical writer before the first source byte
acceptance.observed: Gateway passes a private trusted context callback; MemoryFact invokes EnterCanonical inside Queue.Submit after validation/dedup/cancellation checks. A regression confirms the callback runs before source persistence and that the distinct canonical_operation_id survives source encoding/decoding.

acceptance.criterion: A refused EnterCanonical leaves no canonical source
acceptance.observed: Writer regression makes the callback return an error and verifies the source store remains empty.

acceptance.criterion: Deterministically malformed remember does not enter canonical state
acceptance.observed: Server-handler regression supplies the private callback with blank fact input and confirms validation returns an error without invoking it. Gateway memory/storage limit checks also precede context callback installation by code inspection; no end-to-end quota route harness was run.

acceptance.criterion: Client cannot choose the canonical operation identity
acceptance.observed: A memory-handler regression supplies canonical_operation_id in the public JSON request and verifies the persisted canonical payload leaves it empty without trusted internal context.

acceptance.criterion: Full T23.44 recoverable quota accounting and physical storage admission
acceptance.observed: Still partial: production checker/fence/reconciler and hard allocation-based OS staging admission are not implemented in this change.

limitations: Local tests only; no service deployment or provider qualification was performed.
The writer queue lock covers the source write callback; full brain-fence extent through Git Flush remains for the recovery integration owner.
This change does not implement period-scoped keys, production reconciliation/admin resolution, full normalized-field fingerprints, or physical storage qualification.
